name: bluesky-community-manager
description: Manage Bluesky community activity and publish standalone posts, replies, images, and video through the authenticated Bluesky Community Manager MCP app.

interface.shortDescription: Read Bluesky activity, publish posts, and reply to your community.
interface.longDescription: Use the authenticated Bluesky Community Manager MCP app to review likes, follows, replies, mentions, quotes, reposts, inspect post context, publish standalone posts with text, images, or video, upload ChatGPT-attached media, and publish replies.
